title: Islamic New Year
note: The first day of Muharram begins the Hijri year.

title: Eid Milad-un-Nabi
note: Commemoration of the birth of the Holy Prophet ﷺ; observed dates vary by community.

title: Isra and Mi'raj
note: The night of 27 Rajab; it begins at sunset on 26 Rajab. Observed dates vary.

title: Shab-e-Barat
note: The night of 15 Sha'ban; it begins at sunset on 14 Sha'ban.

title: First of Ramadan
note: The start of fasting depends on the sighting of the moon.

title: Laylat-ul-Qadr
note: Sought on the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan; the 27th night, which begins at sunset on 26 Ramadan, is widely observed.
